title: Glow-Up ROI Cutline
oneLiner: A deadline beauty decision board that ranks skin, hair, body, and styling moves by visible payoff so users stop wasting cash before a date, interview, or photo day.
stitchPrompt: Design a desktop beauty ROI planner called Glow-Up ROI Cutline for people preparing for a date, interview, reunion, or photo-heavy event who want the fastest visible appearance upgrade without wasting money. It should rank skin, hair, body, and styling moves by deadline, cost, and visible payoff, then cut low-impact actions from the plan. Include an event pressure snapshot, a visible payoff ranking board, a budget cutline slider, a skin-hair-style treatment matrix, a seven-day rescue plan, and a confidence before-after notes drawer. Design direction: use a premium-editorial aesthetic with warm ivory tones, polished magazine typography, elegant cards, soft beauty-service accents, and one refined action path so the product feels aspirational, expensive, and calm under pressure.
targetUser: Young professionals and students preparing for a high-visibility moment who want to look sharper fast without buying every clinic package or trending product.
keyUx: Turn appearance anxiety into a ranked cutline: keep only the treatments and habits that fit the deadline, budget, and visible transformation goal.
